name: Summer heat allowance (夏季高温津贴)
authority: 沪人社规〔2019〕19号 (https://service.shanghai.gov.cn/XingZhengWenDangKuJyh/XZGFDetails.aspx?docid=REPORT_NDOC_004501) items 1–3, in force to 31 December 2028 by 沪人社规〔2023〕29号 (https://service.shanghai.gov.cn/XingZhengWenDangKuJyh/XZGFDetails.aspx?docid=231114173331zoDKOF1kRDp0lxO9dqb): from June to September an enterprise that has a worker work in the open air, or cannot bring the workplace below 33℃, pays CNY300 a month; the allowance is in 工资总额. Assign the class only to a worker so exposed (the assignment is the exposure record); the figure keyed on the contract is paid if higher, never less than 300, and nothing from October to May. Wage income: it counts toward IIT and IIT_INTERNAL_RETIREMENT, and as a contract line it is in WAGES (the art.47 average, the annual-leave day wage); outside the minimum-wage comparison (沪人社规〔2025〕10号 item 1(2)). Law silent on a part month: owner rule 2026-09-28 default, prorated like basic (`payroll.allowance_npl_prorates`). Added 29 Sep 2026 in every version (register CN-SH19).
